basic.name: Basic
basic.audience: SMEs that want a solid foundation and coverage of the most common threats.
basic.covered3: Covers the bulk of common attacks
basic.deliverable: Gap report + prioritised remediation plan, ready for the CyFun self-assessment.

important.name: Important
important.audience: NIS2 “important” entities and SMEs handling sensitive or critical data.
important.deliverable: Complete compliance dossier + support through to verification by an accredited body.

essential.name: Essential
essential.audience: NIS2 “essential” entities and organisations with high security requirements.
essential.deliverable: Complete security programme, audit documentation and a multi-year roadmap.
